wom:charybdis.tooltip: Consume Stamina to perform a whirlwind of hit for a total of 8 strikes. Reduce the stamina consumption with sweeping edge.

wom:demonic_ascension.name: Demonic Ascension
wom:demonic_ascension.tooltip:
"The scythe takes possession of your body
 and use it to perform terrible things...."

Ascenscion :
 on a large area, try to Apply Wither effect
 before applying 50% catharsis* on affected entity.

In Demon form:
 Base Duration is equal to 20s x (1 + (Sweeping edge level) / 3).
 Dash attack have twice the chance to apply wither effect but
 will consume more and more health if used multiple times.
 Other attacks will cause 80% Catharsis* on withered entitys if they hit.

 *Catharsis: Reap of the wither effect from the target
 dealing the remaining damage depending on the catharsis percentage at once
 and heal you for the remaining of that percentage.
 catharsis also increase the Demon form
 duration depending on their wither state
 (+3s for wither II and +6s for wither III).

wom:ender_blast.name: Ender blast
wom:ender_blast.tooltip:
"The zenith of the End world technological power."

The blaster loader is composed of 12 chambers.
Kinetic energy is stored in them and transmuted into endpower.
When the trigger is pressed, half of the converted endpower
is condensed into end bullets.
The other half is transfered into a particle accelerator that overcharges
the endpower until it blasts the bullet out with tremendous force and precision.
All of that in just a fraction of a second ... outstanding!

wom:ender_fusion.name: Ender fusion
wom:ender_fusion.tooltip:
"The zenith of the End world technological power."

Two blaster loader with 12 chambers each for 24 in Total.
the Kinetic energy stored is shared between both Blasters
and transmuted into endpower for each.
When the trigger is pressed, half of the converted endpower
is condensed into end bullets.
The other half is transfered into a particle accelerator that overcharges
the endpower until it blasts the bullet out with tremendous force and precision.
All of that in just a fraction of a second ... outstanding!

wom:flash_mutilation.name: Flash mutilation
wom:flash_mutilation.tooltip: Teleport yourself around a target before performing a spin attack.

wom:lunar_eclipse.name: Lunar Eclipse
wom:lunar_eclipse.tooltip:
"Moonlight shadowing the night"

 Strike foes in front of you
 and makes them glow for 7sec.

 In Recto : 
  - Attaking Glowing targets, stack your damage
    and increase their Glowing lvl.
  - Attaking Blind targets, stack your damage
    and remove their Blindness.

 In Verso: 
  - Attaking Glowing targets, stack your damage
    and remove their Glowing.
  - Attaking Blind targets, increase their Blindness lvl

 Recto Jump attack ( Crescent )
  Unleash all stacked damage on the target.
  If it kills the target, it bounce to the closest target
  and loose 5% of its damage.
    Glowing increase the bounce range.
    Blindness increase the damage.

 Verso Jump attack ( Fullmoon )
  Unleash 70% of the stacked damage in Aoe.
    Blindness increase the damage.

wom:orbital_beam.name: Orbital beam
wom:orbital_beam.tooltip: Call an orbital beam that strike foes in your gaze.

wom:plunder_perdition.name: Ender Ritual
wom:plunder_perdition.tooltip:
"Own the ancient arcane of the endermen."

 When triggering this skill, you can choose
 between 4 different type of actions:
  - in neutral and rather close to target, you'll do an [Ender Assault]
    while alternating between left swing and right swing. 
  - While sprinting, you will do an [Ender Assault] and,
    if the attack connect, trigger positive [Ender Snatch].
  - While rising in the air, you will trigger aerian
    [Ender Assault] and, trigger negative [Ender Snatch].
  - While sneaking and with 10 stored stack,
    you'll summon Ender Hands under targets around you.
   Then the hands grasps their respective targets,
    Damagind them and inflicting them with mining fatigue and slowness.

 [Ender Assault] - Teleport you around your target depending
 on the direction you are look at.

 [Ender Snatch] -

wom:rechargement.name: Rechargement
wom:rechargement.tooltip:
"Il n'y a que deux puissances au monde, le sabre et l'esprit : à la longue, le sabre est toujours vaincu par l'esprit."

 After attacking performing skill will reload ammunition
 depending on the attack made before it.

  - 1 ammo after first attack.
  - 2 ammo after the second attacks.
  - 3 ammo afer the third one.

 The last attack of the normal combo will also realod 3 ammo.

 To shoot your ammo, you must perform an attack or a reload first.
 You can also shoot right after sprinting or if you are rising in the air (jumping).

 Dealing damage with a shot will increase [Heatdrive] depending on the bullet type.
 [Heatdrive] slowly decrease if no shot damage is dealt within 4 sec.
 When fully charged, [Heatdrive] become [Souldrive]:
  during that state, the drive will quickly decrease but,
  every second during that state will reload 1 ammo.

 Ammo can be overcharged if rechargement is performed when 6 ammo is allready loaded.
 Overcharged Ammo deal more damage and bypass guards.

 Reloading to reach exactly 6 ammo or 6 overcharged ammo will double
 the reload ammount for as long as you keep your reloads to reach exactly 6.

wom:regierung.name: Regierung
wom:regierung.tooltip:
"Unbreakable defense combined with overwhelming offense rules over battle."

 On cast, you'll perform shield attacks in front of you.
 There is 3 Basic attacks, 1 Dash attack and
 1 Jump attack for both the sword and the shield.

 Some attacks (shields or sword attacks) will move your in front of you.
 While this occure, the shield will have a slight red field around it as an indicator.
 During this short period,you will block incoming attacks and
 perform an automatic counter attack.

 Depending on how you block an attack, you will increase you Shield Charges by a certain amount.
 (increased with sweeping edge lvl)
 Shield Charges can be stored for up to 90 and used in 2 ways:
  - With the Shield, by holding guard and casting a shield attack.
    You will convert all Shield charge into shield Overcharge,
    granting you damage resistance.
  - With the Sword, by holding guard and casting a sword attack.
    You will charge your sword and consume your
     shield charges slowly to perform a spin attack.

 While your shield is Overcharged, your shield attack will do
 increase damage after a sword attack based on the Overcharge amount.

 Getting damaged reduce your Shield Overcharge by 5.
 ( Sweeping edge on your Sword reduce this by 1 per level )

wom:sakura_state.name: Sakura state
wom:sakura_state.tooltip:
"Sharpest blade forged in absolute serenity"

 On cast, you'll perform a Sakura slash.
 Sakura slashes can be declined in 2 form
  - while sprinting,
  you will fastly pass through enemys in front of you, slashing them along the way.  - while sprinting, (cost 2 stack)
  you will fastly pass through enemys in front of you,
  slashing them along the way.
  - while standing or walking, (cost 1 stack)
  you'll fastly slash in front of you.
 Sakura slashes automaticaly sheath your blade afterward.

 You can stack a total of 12 sakura slashes and Sweeping edge
 on your blade will grant you extra stack depending
 on the amount of stack you have on the first cast.
([initial amont of stack] * 1/3 of the sweeping edge levels)

 After the innitial draw, you'll enter sakura state.
 If you don't draw a Sakura slash again within 4 seconds, you loose all your
 stacks and get out of sakura state.

 Slashing a target with a Dash attack or a Sakura slash,
 will stack Perpetual slashes on the target.
 (3 on dashes and sakura slash.
 6 on sakura dash slash
 this value is then multiply by 1/3 of the Sweeping edge lvl).
 If no action is performed for a set of time after landing perpetual slashes,
 All Perpetual slashes stacked on the target are triggered,
 slashing it in sequence for each stacks of Perpetual slashes

wom:solar_arcano.name: Solar Arcano
wom:solar_arcano.tooltip:
"Witness the full force of a star"

 After each basic attack, a special icon will apear within a short period.
 Press the Skill button when you see it to perform a timed Solar attack.
 Solar attack cycle between ignites ( Polvora ) and explode ( Chispear ):

    Polvora : set the target in fire. if target is
    allready in fire, increase ignitions level by 1.
    (can only go up to 2)

    Chispear: if target is in fire, extinguish the fire and
    explode for a set of damage depending on the ignitions level.
    (3 => 6 => 9, +1 per sweeping edge lvl)

 Solar have a unique skill meter mechanique.
 Heat level, wich is showed by the percentage number on the skill,
 can change color (from red to white) depending on the Heating speed.
 Increase Heat level by increasing heating speed above
 the orange lvl by successfully performing Chispear.
 The heating speed increase depends on the target ignition level.

 Hold guard and press skill to perform Solar Brasero.
 Solar Brasero harvest heat level to perform incendiary spell:

    Obscuridad: Infuse your blade with soul fire,
    melting it into a new form.
    All attacks within this form trigger Chispear.
    Lock your heating speed to red.

    Crematorio: breath soul fire in front of you.
    Burns targets to ignitions level 3.
    Durations depends on the amount of time
    they stay in the flame.

    Infierno: Burn target around you in a spherical shape.
    The area of effect will keep growing until 10 sec.
    Every 2sec, target within the area are affected by polvora.
    (can increase ignition level to 3)
    During infierno, all the speed at wich heat level is affected is doubled.
